rationale: The curve is designed with a dead-band between the voltage limits of 0.95 and 1.05 pu to minimize control effort during nominal conditions. The point at 0.94 pu requires injecting 14.29 kVAR (q_fraction=0.142857) to raise the voltage to 0.95 pu. The point at 1.07 pu requires absorbing 28.57 kVAR (q_fraction=-0.285714) to lower the voltage to 1.05 pu. These reactive power values are within the inverter's capability (sqrt(100^2 - 60^2) = 80 kVAR) for those timesteps. The resulting curve is monotonic and corrects all voltage violations.
